scenes.text: Two hundred seventy-five billion dollars in hundred-dollar bills!
That's what Americans are expected to spend online by New Year's.
One bill is four thousandths of an inch thick. Basically nothing.
Now stack two point seven five billion of them. Past the clouds.
Past Mount Everest. Almost thirty-four Everests tall!
At sixty-two miles it hits the edge of space. And it keeps going.
It finally stops at about a hundred eighty-seven miles.
It weighs around three thousand tons. Free shipping, obviously.
And all of it starts with one tiny button. Add to cart.
